# Freelance Dashboard KPI Definition Service

## Purpose
Turns business questions into precise, documented KPI definitions for reporting projects.

## Workflow
1. Interview the client through an approved brief or supplied notes.
2. Define each metric's purpose, formula, unit, time window, filters, exclusions, source, refresh frequency, owner, and known limitations.
3. Identify conflicting definitions and data gaps.
4. Create synthetic examples to test edge cases.
5. Obtain stakeholder sign-off before dashboard implementation.

## Output
KPI dictionary, calculation examples, source mapping, ambiguity register, and dashboard acceptance criteria.

## Safety and limits
- Do not access live analytics or financial accounts. Do not fabricate business results or infer missing data. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
